column1: # Machine-readable half of the terminology policy.
# Each row: a source term that stays English, and the Persian calque that
# must never appear in its place. `scripts/check-fa.py` reads this file and
# fails the build when the forbidden form shows up in a translation.
#   english          form that must survive in the output (singular stem
#                    of a kept term; regular plurals are stem + ها, not -s)
#   forbidden_fa     Persian form that is wrong for this source term
#   levels           `system-docs` = one-word field noun, skipped at journal
#                    `all` = multi-word label / named phrase, both levels
# The checker reads every row. There is no `--domains` switch and no
# per-field pack. `--level journal` skips `system-docs` rows so a paper
# may use پیاده‌سازی / گره. Add a row here at the same time you add a
# Keep-English note in glossary.md; this file is the single source of
# truth for the checker. Document-specific field terms are inferred from
# the source and locked in the job's terms.tsv, not here.
